resources.string: Cannot preview Android audio stream %1$d on this device.
0 is automatic; 1–20 select an audio stream. Tap to preview. Applies after reconnecting.
Lower music for navigation and mute it for calls or Siri speech. Try turning off if audio is silent. Applies after reconnecting.
Mute media when audio focus is lost
Mute during audio interruptions and resume when focus returns. Turn off if audio does not resume. Applies after reconnecting.
